Batch 17 is complete. Summary of what was delivered and verified:

## Deliverables (all under `research/`)
- `frontier-40-geometry-braids-rep-27-batch-17.pages.json` — final manifest: 17 A items + 2 B items on orders 883/884, every item labelled with `dependency_level` (0–12, tool-verified), full statements, proof strategies, provenance and source references.
- `frontier-40-geometry-braids-rep-27-batch-17.coverage.json` — source-anchored harvest: 2 pages, 48 harvested rows, 0 errors/warnings; 8/9 sources fetch-stamped, 1 documented drop.
- `frontier-40-geometry-braids-rep-27-batch-17.notes.md` — scope/plan reconciliation, source work, corrections, check results, caveats.
- `frontier-40-geometry-braids-rep-27-batch-17.cross-batch-dependencies.json` — 24 consumer rows (1 page + 23 item edges to batch 16), all merged into the refreshed unified ledger.
- 19 `frontier-40-geometry-braids-rep-27-step1-<id>.json` readiness records, all `ready`, none owner-held.

## Key mathematics and sourcing
- **Design source gate closed with Dolgachev** (the design named MFK *or* Dolgachev): retrieved the full 232-page book, read Ch. 6.1, 7.1, 8.1–8.3 and in full **Theorem 8.1 (pp. 118–120) and Proposition 8.1 (pp. 120–121)** — exactly the omitted Brion 1.35 proof — plus Brion, Hoskins and Newstead in full text. Dolgachev is now cited on nine items with exact locators.
- **MFK** retained as a genuine six-attempt drop (Springer bot-wall, borrow-only archive.org, Google Books, HathiTrust 403, author page 403) with two web searches; its harvest is covered by the alternative argument.
- **Newstead** recovered through a stamped Wayback copy of the official HAL file after the HAL URLs were bot-walled; twelve failed attempts preserved as history.
- **Corrections made:** the projective-line example's action/weights were sign-inconsistent under the standard linearization, and its "trivial stabilizers" claim was wrong (stabilizer is μ₂) — both fixed; the localization strategy now proves well-definedness of the localized Reynolds operator; a nonexistent "Hoskins Example 4.13" pointer was replaced. The prior attempt's future-dated retrieval log and its false "Dolgachev unavailable" claim were withdrawn and replaced with genuine evidence.

## Checks (actual)
`coverage-checklist --require-destination` 0/0; `source-fetch-check` 8/9 stamped, 9/9 resolved; `url-sweep` 6/6 live; `source-backing` all backed; `manifest-deps` 0 errors; whole-run `content-policy --manifest-only` 766 items, 0 errors/warnings; `manifest-integrity` no scope drift; `validate-plan` acyclic; `item-dependency-levels` clean for batch 17 (remaining run-wide errors are other units' empty inventories). Step 3 still owes the authored item proofs — scaffold readiness is not proof acceptance.
